purpose: Installed consumers need the marker to discover an inline-typed library's type information. A small VCS-distributed library can preserve that metadata just as other Python libraries do. Whether all promises inline typing remains an explicit acceptance decision; no packaging constraint requiring omission was found.
first_step: Read the owning issue and .reference/test_policy.py; rerun .reference/reproduce.py against its audited source commits. Independently accept, adapt, defer, or reject the reference. Do not merge this reference branch wholesale.

limitations: Deliberately untyped libraries, separate stub-only packages and non-Python tools have different contracts. Namespace subpackages own their markers. This does not prove annotation completeness, correctness, static-analysis success or full native packaging qualification. See the [typing distribution specification](https://typing.python.org/en/latest/spec/distributing.html#packaging-type-information).
